changelog:
Initial release: Unified economic data API for agents

- Access 800k+ Federal Reserve (FRED) economic series and World Bank country indicators
- Retrieve derived US market stats (housing affordability, market vitality, industry saturation)
- Pay-per-call in USDC via x402—no API key or signup required
- Search FRED series by keyword or ID; get World Bank data by country
- Designed for macroeconomic research, market analysis, and economic indicator retrieval
